courses_research_notes: PATTS publicly lists eight collegiate offerings (homepage: '8 Academic Programs'): six four-year BS degrees, BS Tourism Management, and the two-year Aircraft Technician Course diploma. CHED/TESDA/PRC/CAAP-accredited; CAAP ATO for airframe, powerplant, and avionics. SHS STEM and ABM strands feed into these programs but are excluded from popularCourses. Runtime already had BS Aeronautical Engineering; enrichment adds the full official aviation portfolio.
